drug_name: Allium Cepa / Arsenicum Album / Nux Vomica / Pulsatilla Pratensis / Kentucky Bluegrass / Orchard Grass / Bermuda Grass / Johnson Grass / Rye Grass / Vernal Grass / Bahia Grass / Timothy Grass (Homeopathic Allergy Relief)
what_its_for: This homeopathic medicine is used to help relieve common allergy symptoms, including runny nose, sneezing, watery or itchy eyes, nasal congestion, and throat irritation. It is especially helpful during grass pollen season or when you are around things like onions or other environmental triggers. The ingredients are highly diluted natural substances traditionally used to support your body's own ability to manage allergy-like symptoms.
how_to_take: Place the recommended number of tablets or drops under your tongue and let them dissolve completely. Do NOT swallow them whole or chew them. Try to take this medicine at least 15 to 30 minutes before or after eating, drinking, or brushing your teeth. Keep your mouth clean and free of strong flavors like mint or coffee when taking this product, as these may affect how it works. Wash your hands before handling the tablets if possible.
dosing: Adults and children 12 years and older: Take 1 to 2 tablets (or as directed on the product label) up to 3 to 4 times daily, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Children under 12 years: Ask a doctor before use, as dosing may differ. Follow the exact dosing instructions printed on your product's label, since formulas may vary by brand. Do not take more than the recommended amount.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do NOT double up doses to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store at room temperature, between 59°F and 77°F (15°C and 25°C). Keep away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture. Do not store in the bathroom. Keep the container tightly closed when not in use. Keep this product out of reach of children and pets. Do not use if the seal is broken or missing.
what_to_avoid: Avoid eating, drinking (especially coffee, mint teas, or alcohol), or brushing your teeth for at least 15 to 30 minutes before and after taking this medicine. Avoid strong-smelling substances like camphor, eucalyptus, menthol, or mint products close to the time you take your dose, as these may reduce effectiveness. Do not use this product as a replacement for prescription allergy medications without first speaking to your doctor, especially if your symptoms are severe.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away if you experience: difficulty breathing or shortness of breath, severe swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat (signs of a serious allergic reaction), chest tightness or wheezing, high fever, symptoms that get significantly worse or do not improve after 7 days of use, new or unusual symptoms that concern you, or if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or giving this to a young child and have not yet consulted a healthcare provider.
when_it_works: Some people notice improvement in their symptoms within 20 to 30 minutes of taking a dose. Full benefit may take several days of consistent use, especially during allergy season. Results can vary from person to person. If you do not see any improvement after 7 days of regular use, talk to your doctor or pharmacist about other options.
special_populations: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Talk to your doctor before using this product if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Although homeopathic medicines contain highly diluted ingredients, it is always best to check with your healthcare provider first. Children: Children under 12 years of age should only use this product under the guidance of a doctor. Elderly: No special precautions are generally required for older adults, but always review all medications with your pharmacist to check for interactions. Allergies: If you are allergic to any of the listed plant ingredients (such as grasses or onion-related plants), speak to your doctor before use.
